itens.titulo: Palantir raises full-year revenue outlook as US commercial sales accelerate
itens.descricao: Palantir raises full-year revenue outlook as US commercial sales accelerate Yahoo Finance Singapore
trechos: Palantir reported Q3 revenue of $2.313 billion, a 96% increase from the previous year.
Wall Street had expected revenue of $2.17 billion, according to Bloomberg data.
Palantir now sees full-year revenue between $8.530 billion and $8.534 billion, topping analyst estimates of $8.2 billion.
The company also raised its US commercial sales target to more than $3.559 billion.
Adjusted earnings per share of $0.44 also beat consensus estimates of $0.40.
What else you need to know: Palantir stock is up roughly 2% year-to-date, even as the company has been caught in the recent tech sell-off.

itens.titulo: Palantir reports booming U.S. commercial revenue growth, topping government for first time
itens.descricao: Palantir reports booming U.S. commercial revenue growth, topping government for first time CNBC
trechos: Net income more than doubled to $1.13 billion, or 44 cents per share, from about $476 million, or 18 cents per share.
Palantir has long been known for its strength in the government sector, but its commercial segment caught up in Q3.
commercial revenue jumped 148% to $984 million, surpassing U.S.
government revenue of $953 million, which was up 96%.

Last quarter, the company boosted its forecast to $3.42 billion.
The company projects about $2.65 billion in revenue for the fourth quarter and about $8.53 billion for full-year 2026.
